log_semantics: active_means are FP32 sum over H8 rows with preaction phase<150 divided by max(actual active_rows,1), detached for logging. Physical soft survival/gamma are not included in this denominator.

equations.active_weighted_global_mean: sum_i A_i*m_i(T) / sum_i A_i, evaluated in F64; aggregation of rounded logged means, not reconstruction of original row tensors
equations.nonzero_mean_update_count_P: count_i[m_i(P)>0] using exact logged numeric comparison, no tuned epsilon
equations.nonzero_mean_update_count_other: count_i[m_i(T)!=0]; not fraction of individual rows with T>0
equations.support_raw: official support-match S, dimensionless; P_ONLY still computes/logs it diagnostically
equations.A2_weighted_support: m_i(w*S); use m_i(S) only after frozen all151 phase_weight1 proof and logged active phase_weight1 check
equations.dt_scaled_contribution: .02*logged or component mean, dt applied once
equations.identity_residual: logged bonus minus source formula from logged means, saved as raw arithmetic diagnostic; no post-data accuracy threshold

units.P: dimensionless squared normalized sampled SDF excess; not mm depth
units.S: dimensionless soft geometric support match; not force/contact probability
units.dt_scaled: per20ms imagined reward contribution before gamma/survival
units.active_rows: imagined H8 sample rows, not physical worlds or independent observations
